external_collaboration.evidence_quote: In 2020, Moyer’s Chicks in Quakertown, Pennsylvania, joined the Hoover’s family. Today, Moyer’s Ready-to-Lay Pullets helps keepers across the Mid-Atlantic and Northeast get a head start with young hens approaching laying age. With the brooding and early growing stages already handled, keepers can focus on welcoming their birds home and looking forward to their first eggs.

Privett Hatchery joined Hoover’s in 2023, bringing a long history of poultry breeding and a selection of rare and uncommon birds. For keepers interested in trying a different breed or adding variety to their flock, Privett offers more to discover.
Estes Hatchery in Mount Vernon, Missouri, is the newest addition to the Hoover’s family, extending our reach and adding to the experience we share.
